decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 9.2	The installation of new UPVC windows to the front of the house is, on balance, considered to be satisfactory, as, due to the proportions, design and scale of the windows, and retention of the original door, it achieves the aims of retaining the original appearance the house, which preserves and enhances the character and appearance of Gunnersbury Park Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas, and the Supplementary Planning Guidance and draft Conservation Area appraisal
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Replacement of existing windows with UPC windows to  front elevation to house
